description: Character monitor and skill planner for EVE Online: skills, training queues, assets, market orders, industry jobs, mail and notifications for several characters.
notes: Settings, characters and ESI logins live in %APPDATA%\EVEMon, outside the Scoop folder:
they survive updates and are kept on uninstall.
The last two parts of the version are the upload time (UTC) of the installer: upstream rebuilds
and re-uploads EVEMon-<version>.msi under the same version after its weekly game data updates.
EVEMon downloads game data updates by itself, so you do not need to update for those.
EVEMon 5.0 ships its own .NET 8 runtime. .NET 8 reached end of support on 10 November 2026;
this build gets no more .NET security fixes until upstream moves to a newer .NET.
Leave the IGB server (Options > General) off, or at least not public: in public mode it listens
on all interfaces and shows your characters' data to anyone on the network.

script: # The version on main is what the next installer will carry; the upload time of that installer
# tells re-uploads under the same version apart.
